correctness.rationale: On GP(8,3), independently rebuilt 16 vertices/24 edges, all shortest distances, and 249 augmented faces at graph radius two (f-vector 16,72,112,48 plus empty). Reconstructed the two actual 119-pair discrete-Morse matchings with 688 oriented Hasse covers and independently verified each matching is acyclic, critical cells nine 2-cells and two 3-cells, no 1-cells. Two 8-vertex bipartition-induced S3 crosspolytope cycles are independent in top integral homology because there are no 4-simplices; with exactly two critical 3-cells this forces zero Morse attaching degrees and integral wedge ∨9 S2 ∨2 S3. Radius3 has exactly 8 antipodal forbidden pairs, giving S7; first stage cycle rank9 and radius4 simplex. All intervals follow distinct degrees; proof reconstructs integral homotopy, not just mod-p ranks.
residual_risks: The direct integral Morse boundary was not separately recomputed numerically in this independent check; zero follows from the two independent integral top cycles and critical cell counts, with Hurewicz.
